documentaryPhoto.prompt:
Use case: historical-scene, photographic concept asset. Direction name: 창가에서 책을 읽는 노인.
Create ONE standalone archival-documentary-style photograph, landscape 4:3, composition intended as an app's atmospheric hero asset, not a UI mockup. No typography, captions, dates, logos or graphic overlays. Date anchor of design project is2026-10-20; image itself has no date. This is a newly generated fictional period scene, NOT a reproduction or claim of an actual archive.
User specifically requests a Joseon-era Korean male grandfather who DOES NOT look at the camera, with the feel of a photograph casually recorded by an American missionary visiting Korea around the late19th/early20th-century transition.
Reference roles: attached black-and-white small interior scene gives understated documentary room framing, grain and everyday activity; attached prior mobile concept gives ONLY loose character continuity for an original elderly Korean male and traditional study. Discard all prior app UI and the posed eye contact/beauty-photo treatment.
A genuinely elderly Korean man with a weathered face, sparse white beard, modest worn pale hanbok and an unostentatious cloth head covering, seated cross-legged at a low wooden desk in a dim ordinary hanok room, quietly READING an open bound book. Camera is a few meters away, slightly off to his SIDE, nearly a three-quarter profile. His head is bent30degrees, both eyes unambiguously directed DOWN at the pages. He is completely absorbed, unaware of the photographer; no smile for viewer, no head raised toward lens, no staged dignified portrait, NO EYE CONTACT. The room occupies more of the frame than his face; include bare plaster, wooden lattice window, uneven floor, simple everyday possessions, small untidy book pile. He sits off-center naturally; imperfect ordinary framing, not a polished symmetric film set.
Visual medium: convincing modest late19th/early20th photographic print scan, neutral monochrome with just slightly warm aged paper base, soft low-resolution detail, muted contrast, compressed tonal range, imperfect exposure with bright window and dark room, old-lens edge softness, subtle long-exposure softness around the fingers and tiny natural print wear. Texture should be embedded naturally, not a clean modern DSLR photo with a generic grain filter. No dramatic studio rim lighting, no modern cinematic shallow-depth-of-field bokeh, no glossy skin, no ultra-sharp whiskers, no fashionable wardrobe, no fantasy smoke, no theatrical sage costume or shiny props, no overdone scratches. Keep it humane, observant, plain, quiet, and unromanticized. Photograph fills canvas without a decorative card frame.

ONE mobile welcome screen, logical390x844 portrait, app content only, no device/OS/browser frames, no multi-screen collage. Current design date2026-10-20, no visible years or dates.
User correction: a Joseon male grandfather MUST NOT LOOK AT CAMERA; the photograph should feel like a plain historical documentary photograph made by a visiting American missionary, not a polished portrait. User also explicitly asks that design direction be based on actually checked Kim Guija app. Attached references have now been directly inspected:
Reference1 our ORIGINAL fictional male grandfather photograph: use this precise scene and downward reading pose as the main image; retain his downward eyes, distance, side view, modest clothing, room and old photographic grain. No eye contact anywhere, no isolated face medallion looking at viewer.
Reference2 developer-published actual app introduction screenshot: use only restrained dark brown/ink atmosphere, story-first grouping, serif/brush heading relationship, small red detail, spacious layout.
Reference3 actual app empty-state screenshot: use only aged cream hanji surface, generous quiet space, subtle warm brown strokes.
Reference4 actual app letter screenshot: use only a restrained paper-and-ink material feeling.
Do not reproduce the female character, competitor title, biography, dates, exact copy, screenshots as UI content, logos, or medical/predictive claims. Own app remains two-person birthday entry and traditional SYMBOL explanation, no chat box, no new chat navigation, no divination scores.
Layout: muted deep ink-brown full base with large margins; small masthead “사주 할아버지” and unobtrusive “보관함”. Large readable but restrained heading “두 사람의 이야기를” newline “차분히 살펴보세.” Below it a landscape photograph panel with slight real print edge (not a glossy rounded card), showing the original male reading at desk, room visible and face small. Under photo one thin divider, then a brief warm-ivory text block on same dark surface “생일로 살펴보는 사주 기호”. Supporting line “내 정보와 상대의 생일을 차례로 적어 주세요.” One wide muted parchment button with dark lettering “두 사람의 생일 적기”. Subtle lower caption “점수 없는 설명형 베타”. A tiny red square seal mark as decoration, no text inside it.
Photos must remain low contrast print scans but UI TEXT MUST HAVE STRONG readable contrast, never copy competitor's low-contrast tiny gray text. Body18–20 logicalpx, CTA56px+ height. Korean typography at most2fonts, calm modern Korean serif plus legible sans for controls, no ornamental oversized slogan. No cherry blossom decorations, no novelty fortune cards, no glossy gradients, no harsh cinematic rim light. Picture fills about35percent of screen; whole layout fits844logicalpx without clipping.
